details.judge_reply:
Explanation:  
The Ground Truth Answer identifies Charles Hoskinson as the individual of interest, noting that he resides in Wheatland, which is also the name of the James Buchanan House. It states that Charles Hoskinson co-founded Ethereum (released in 2015) and then founded Cardano (released in 2017), with two years elapsing between the launches.

The Predicted Answer instead identifies Gavin Wood as the relevant individual, and provides details about the launch dates of Ethereum (2015) and Polkadot (2020), resulting in about 4 years and 10 months difference.

The substance of the Ground Truth Answer—specifically, the identification of the individual (Charles Hoskinson), the platforms (Ethereum and Cardano), the relationship to Wheatland, and the elapsed time of two years—is completely absent from the Predicted Answer. The Predicted Answer not only identifies a different individual but also different blockchain platforms and a different elapsed time.

Decision: FALSE
